content.arguments:
{"file_path":"src/StreamTranslator.App/MainWindow.xaml","new_string":"                    <Grid x:Name="HomePage">
                        <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                            <StackPanel Margin="32,24,32,32">
                                <!-- 页头：标题 + 实时状态与断句策略摘要徽章 -->
                                <DockPanel Margin="0,0,0,16">
                                    <TextBlock Text="实时字幕"
                                               Style="{StaticResource PageTitleText}"
                                               VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                    <Border x:Name="HomeStateBadge"
                                            DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                                            VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                            Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}"
                                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource CardStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                                            BorderThickness="1"
                                            CornerRadius="14"
                                            Padding="12,5">
                                        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                            <Ellipse x:Name="HomeStateDot"
                                                     Width="8"
                                                     Height="8"
                                                     Fill="{DynamicResource AcousticIdleBrush}"
                                                     Margin="0,0,8,0"
                                                     VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                            <TextBlock x:Name="HomeStateBadgeText"
                                                       Text="就绪"
                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentTextFillColorPrimaryBrush}"
                                                       FontSize="12"
                                                       FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                       VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                            <Border Width="1"
                                                    Height="11"
                                                    Background="{DynamicResource DividerStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                                                    Margin="8,0"
                                                    VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                            <TextBlock x:Name="HomeVadBadgeText"
                                                       Text="均衡 400ms"
                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorSecondaryBrush}"
                                                       FontSize="12"
                                                       Typography.NumeralAlignment="Tabular"
                                                       VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                        </StackPanel>
                                    </Border>
                                </DockPanel>

                                <!-- 不用 ui:InfoBar：其模板在 IsOpen=False 初始布局时的
                                     BorderBrush Storyboard 会抛 InvalidOperationException。 -->
                                <Border x:Name="ApiKeyGuidanceBar"
                                        AutomationProperties.AutomationId="ApiKeyGuidanceBar"
                                        Background="{DynamicResource SystemFillColorAttentionBackgroundBrush}"
                                        BorderBrush="{DynamicResource CardStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                                        BorderThickness="1"
                                        CornerRadius="8"
                                        Padding="16,12"
                                        Margin="0,0,0,16"
                                        Visibility="Collapsed">
                                    <DockPanel>
                                        <ui:SymbolIcon Symbol="Info24"
                                                       DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                                                       Margin="0,2,12,0"
                                                       VerticalAlignment="Top"
                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentTextFillColorPrimaryBrush}" />
                                        <ui:Button DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                                   Content="前往设置"
                                                   AutomationProperties.AutomationId="ApiKeyGuidanceSettingsButton"
                                                   Icon="{ui:SymbolIcon Settings24}"
                                                   Click="OnGoToSettingsClick"
                                                   Margin="16,0,0,0"
                                                   VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                        <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                            <TextBlock Text="尚未配置识别服务"
                                                       FontSize="14"
                                                       FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorPrimaryBrush}" />
                                            <TextBlock Text="开始字幕前，请先在“设置 → 识别服务”中填写 API Key。"
                                                       Style="{StaticResource CaptionText}"
                                                       TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                                       Margin="0,2,0,0" />
                                        </StackPanel>
                                    </DockPanel>
                                </Border>

                                <!-- 层级一：演播控制带 (Hero Stage) -->
                                <Border x:Name="HomeControlBar"
                                        Style="{StaticResource HeroPanelBorder}">
                                    <StackPanel>
                                        <!-- 第一排：主操作按钮 + 运行状态摘要 -->
                                        <DockPanel Margin="0,0,0,18">
                                            <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                                                        Orientation="Horizontal"
                                                        VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                                <ui:Button x:Name="StartStopButton"
                                                           AutomationProperties.AutomationId="StartStopButton"
                                                           Appearance="Primary"
                                                           Click="OnStartStopClick"
                                                           Height="38"
                                                           MinWidth="132"
                                                           Padding="16,0"
                                                           Margin="0,0,10,0">
                                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                                        <ui:ProgressRing x:Name="StartStopProgressRing"
                                                                         IsIndeterminate="True"
                                                                         Width="16"
                                                                         Height="16"
                                                                         Margin="0,0,8,0"
                                                                         Visibility="Collapsed" />
                                                        <ui:SymbolIcon x:Name="StartStopIcon" Symbol="Play24" Margin="0,0,8,0" />
                                                        <TextBlock x:Name="StartStopText" Text="开始字幕" FontWeight="SemiBold" />
                                                    </StackPanel>
                                                </ui:Button>
                                                <ui:Button x:Name="HomeFloatingWindowButton"
                                                           AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeFloatingWindowButton"
                                                           AutomationProperties.Name="显示悬浮窗"
                                                           Click="OnShowFloatingWindowClick"
                                                           Height="38"
                                                           MinWidth="116"
                                                           Margin="0,0,8,0">
                                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                                        <ui:SymbolIcon x:Name="FloatingWindowIcon" Symbol="Window24" Margin="0,0,8,0" />
                                                        <TextBlock x:Name="HomeFloatingWindowText" Text="显示悬浮窗" />
                                                    </StackPanel>
                                                </ui:Button>
                                                <ui:Button x:Name="HomeFloatingLockButton"
                                                           AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeFloatingLockButton"
                                                           ToolTip="锁定或解锁悬浮窗（Ctrl+Alt+L）"
                                                           Click="OnToggleFloatingLockClick"
                                                           Height="38"
                                                           MinWidth="92">
                                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                                        <ui:SymbolIcon x:Name="HomeFloatingLockIcon" Symbol="LockClosed24" Margin="0,0,6,0" />
                                                        <TextBlock x:Name="HomeFloatingLockText" Text="锁定" />
                                                    </StackPanel>
                                                </ui:Button>
                                            </StackPanel>

                                            <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                                        HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                                                        VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                        Margin="16,0,0,0">
                                                <TextBlock x:Name="HomeRuntimeSummaryText"
                                                           AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeControlBar"
                                                           Text="未启动，等待开始"
                                                           FontSize="13"
                                                           FontWeight="Medium"
                                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorPrimaryBrush}"
                                                           HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                                                           TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                                                <TextBlock x:Name="HomeActiveServiceSummaryText"
                                                           Text="识别：MiMo ASR · 翻译：已关闭"
                                                           Style="{StaticResource CaptionText}"
                                                           HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                                                           Margin="0,2,0,0"
                                                           TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                                            </StackPanel>
                                        </DockPanel>

                                        <!-- 第二排：高频快捷切换带（输出设备 + 翻译开关与目标语言） -->
                                        <Border Background="{DynamicResource SubtleFillColorSecondaryBrush}"
                                                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource CardStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                                                BorderThickness="1"
                                                CornerRadius="8"
                                                Padding="14,10"
                                                Margin="0,0,0,18">
                                            <Grid>
                                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="1.25*" />
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="20" />
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="20" />
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="1*" />
                                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                                                <!-- 输出设备快捷选择 -->
                                                <DockPanel Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                                    <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                                                               Text="输出设备"
                                                               FontSize="12"
                                                               FontWeight="Medium"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorSecondaryBrush}"
                                                               VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                               Margin="0,0,10,0" />
                                                    <ui:Button x:Name="HomeRefreshAudioDevicesButton"
                                                               DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                                               ToolTip="刷新音频输出设备列表"
                                                               Width="32"
                                                               Height="32"
                                                               Padding="0"
                                                               Margin="6,0,0,0"
                                                               Click="OnRefreshAudioDevicesClick">
                                                        <ui:SymbolIcon Symbol="ArrowClockwise24" FontSize="14" />
                                                    </ui:Button>
                                                    <ComboBox x:Name="HomeAudioDeviceComboBox"
                                                              AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeAudioDeviceComboBox"
                                                              Height="32"
                                                              SelectionChanged="OnHomeAudioDeviceSelectionChanged" />
                                                </DockPanel>

                                                <Border Grid.Column="2"
                                                        Width="1"
                                                        Height="22"
                                                        Background="{DynamicResource DividerStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                                                        VerticalAlignment="Center" />

                                                <!-- 翻译快速开关与目标语言 -->
                                                <DockPanel x:Name="HomeTranslationQuickBar"
                                                           Grid.Column="4"
                                                           VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                                    <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                                                               Text="字幕翻译"
                                                               FontSize="12"
                                                               FontWeight="Medium"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorSecondaryBrush}"
                                                               VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                               Margin="0,0,10,0" />
                                                    <ui:ToggleSwitch x:Name="HomeTranslationEnabledSwitch"
                                                                     AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeTranslationEnabledSwitch"
                                                                     DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                                                                     OffContent="关"
                                                                     OnContent="开"
                                                                     Margin="0,0,10,0"
                                                                     VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                                     Checked="OnHomeTranslationEnabledChanged"
                                                                     Unchecked="OnHomeTranslationEnabledChanged" />
                                                    <ComboBox x:Name="HomeTranslationTargetLanguageBox"
                                                              AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeTranslationTargetLanguageBox"
                                                              Height="32"
                                                              MinWidth="112"
                                                              SelectionChanged="OnHomeTranslationTargetLanguageChanged">
                                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="译为 中文" Tag="zh-Hans" />
                                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="译为 英语" Tag="en" />
                                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="译为 德语" Tag="de" />
                                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="译为 法语" Tag="fr" />
                                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="译为 日语" Tag="ja" />
                                                    </ComboBox>
                                                </DockPanel>
                                            </Grid>
                                        </Border>

                                        <!-- 保留 CurrentAudioDeviceText 供现有逻辑与 UIA 自动化兼容 -->
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="CurrentAudioDeviceText"
                                                   AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeAudioDeviceText"
                                                   Text="默认设备"
                                                   Height="0"
                                                   Opacity="0"
                                                   IsHitTestVisible="False" />

                                        <!-- 第三排：分段 LED 声学电平仪 + 实时人声/识别状态灯 -->
                                        <Grid>
                                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="0"
                                                       Text="输入电平"
                                                       FontSize="12"
                                                       FontWeight="Medium"
                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorSecondaryBrush}"
                                                       VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                       Margin="0,0,12,0" />

                                            <Grid Grid.Column="1" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                                <controls:SegmentedLevelMeter x:Name="AudioLevelMeter"
                                                                              Height="14"
                                                                              SegmentCount="32"
                                                                              InactiveBrush="{DynamicResource AcousticMeterTrackBrush}"
                                                                              NormalBrush="{DynamicResource AcousticLiveBrush}"
                                                                              WarmBrush="{DynamicResource AcousticWarmBrush}"
                                                                              PeakBrush="{DynamicResource AcousticPeakBrush}" />
                                                <!-- 保留 ProgressBar 隐藏于底层，保持 HomeAudioLevelBar 的 UIA 契约 -->
                                                <ProgressBar x:Name="AudioLevelBar"
                                                             AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeAudioLevelBar"
                                                             AutomationProperties.Name="输入电平"
                                                             Minimum="0"
                                                             Maximum="100"
                                                             Height="1"
                                                             Opacity="0"
                                                             IsHitTestVisible="False" />
                                            </Grid>

                                            <TextBlock x:Name="HomeAudioLevelText"
                                                       Grid.Column="2"
                                                       Text="0%"
                                                       Width="40"
                                                       TextAlignment="Right"
                                                       FontSize="12"
                                                       FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                       Typography.NumeralAlignment="Tabular"
                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorPrimaryBrush}"
                                                       VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                       Margin="10,0,12,0" />

                                            <Border x:Name="HomeVoiceActivityBadge"
                                                    Grid.Column="3"
                                                    Background="{DynamicResource SubtleFillColorSecondaryBrush}"
                                                    BorderBrush="{DynamicResource CardStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                                                    BorderThickness="1"
                                                    CornerRadius="10"
                                                    Padding="9,3"
                                                    VerticalAlignment="Center">

                                            <StackPanel Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="1">
                                                <TextBlock Text="语音检测" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabelText}" />
                                                <TextBlock x:Name="VadStatusText"
                                                           AutomationProperties.AutomationId="OverviewSpeechDetectionStatus"
                                                           Text="等待模型"
                                                           Style="{StaticResource FieldValueText}" />
                                            </StackPanel>
                                            <StackPanel Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="2">
                                                <TextBlock Text="识别进程" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabelText}" />
                                                <TextBlock x:Name="WorkerStatusText"
                                                           AutomationProperties.AutomationId="OverviewRecognitionWorkerStatus"
                                                           Text="未启动"
                                                           Style="{StaticResource FieldValueText}" />
                                            </StackPanel>
                                            <StackPanel Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="3">
                                                <TextBlock Text="识别接口" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabelText}" />
                                                <TextBlock x:Name="ApiStatusText"
                                                           AutomationProperties.AutomationId="OverviewRecognitionApiStatus"
                                                           Text="未测试"
                                                           Style="{StaticResource FieldValueText}" />
                                            </StackPanel>
                                            <StackPanel Grid.Row="2" Grid.Column="0">
                                                <TextBlock Text="翻译进程" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabelText}" />
                                                <TextBlock x:Name="TranslationWorkerStatusText"
                                                           AutomationProperties.AutomationId="OverviewTranslationWorkerStatus"
                                                           Text="已关闭"
                                                           Style="{StaticResource FieldValueText}" />
                                            </StackPanel>
                                            <StackPanel Grid.Row="2" Grid.Column="1">
                                                <TextBlock Text="翻译接口" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabelText}" />
                                                <TextBlock x:Name="TranslationApiStatusText"
                                                           AutomationProperties.AutomationId="OverviewTranslationApiStatus"
                                                           Text="已关闭"
                                                           Style="{StaticResource FieldValueText}" />
                                            </StackPanel>
                                            <StackPanel Grid.Row="2" Grid.Column="2">
                                                <TextBlock Text="字幕输出" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabelText}" />
                                                <TextBlock x:Name="SubtitleOutputStatusText"
                                                           AutomationProperties.AutomationId="OverviewSubtitleOutputStatus"
                                                           Text="等待字幕"
                                                           Style="{StaticResource FieldValueText}" />
                                            </StackPanel>
                                        </Grid>

                                    </StackPanel>
                                </Border>

                                <Border x:Name="HomeIssuesCard"
                                        Style="{StaticResource PanelBorder}">
                                    <StackPanel>
                                        <TextBlock Text="问题"
                                                   AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeIssuesPanel"
                                                   Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleText}" />
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="LastErrorText"
                                                   Text="无"
                                                   TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                                   FontSize="14"
                                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorPrimaryBrush}" />
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="TranslationIssueText"
                                                   AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeTranslationIssueText"
                                                   Visibility="Collapsed"
                                                   TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                                   FontSize="14"
                                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource SystemFillColorCautionBrush}"
                                                   Margin="0,12,0,0" />
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </Border>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </ScrollViewer>
                    </Grid>"}

{"file_path":"src/StreamTranslator.App/MainWindow.xaml","new_string":"                    <Grid x:Name="HomePage">
                        <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                            <StackPanel Margin="32,24,32,32">
                                <!-- 页头：标题 + 实时状态与断句策略摘要徽章 -->
                                <DockPanel Margin="0,0,0,16">
                                    <TextBlock Text="实时字幕"
                                               Style="{StaticResource PageTitleText}"
                                               VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                    <Border x:Name="HomeStateBadge"
                                            DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                                            VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                            Background="{DynamicResource CardBackgroundFillColorDefaultBrush}"
                                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource CardStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                                            BorderThickness="1"
                                            CornerRadius="14"
                                            Padding="12,5">
                                        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                            <Ellipse x:Name="HomeStateDot"
                                                     Width="8"
                                                     Height="8"
                                                     Fill="{DynamicResource AcousticIdleBrush}"
                                                     Margin="0,0,8,0"
                                                     VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                            <TextBlock x:Name="HomeStateBadgeText"
                                                       Text="就绪"
                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentTextFillColorPrimaryBrush}"
                                                       FontSize="12"
                                                       FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                       VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                            <Border Width="1"
                                                    Height="11"
                                                    Background="{DynamicResource DividerStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                                                    Margin="8,0"
                                                    VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                            <TextBlock x:Name="HomeVadBadgeText"
                                                       Text="均衡 400ms"
                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorSecondaryBrush}"
                                                       FontSize="12"
                                                       Typography.NumeralAlignment="Tabular"
                                                       VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                        </StackPanel>
                                    </Border>
                                </DockPanel>

                                <!-- 不用 ui:InfoBar：其模板在 IsOpen=False 初始布局时的
                                     BorderBrush Storyboard 会抛 InvalidOperationException。 -->
                                <Border x:Name="ApiKeyGuidanceBar"
                                        AutomationProperties.AutomationId="ApiKeyGuidanceBar"
                                        Background="{DynamicResource SystemFillColorAttentionBackgroundBrush}"
                                        BorderBrush="{DynamicResource CardStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                                        BorderThickness="1"
                                        CornerRadius="8"
                                        Padding="16,12"
                                        Margin="0,0,0,16"
                                        Visibility="Collapsed">
                                    <DockPanel>
                                        <ui:SymbolIcon Symbol="Info24"
                                                       DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                                                       Margin="0,2,12,0"
                                                       VerticalAlignment="Top"
                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentTextFillColorPrimaryBrush}" />
                                        <ui:Button DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                                   Content="前往设置"
                                                   AutomationProperties.AutomationId="ApiKeyGuidanceSettingsButton"
                                                   Icon="{ui:SymbolIcon Settings24}"
                                                   Click="OnGoToSettingsClick"
                                                   Margin="16,0,0,0"
                                                   VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                        <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                            <TextBlock Text="尚未配置识别服务"
                                                       FontSize="14"
                                                       FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorPrimaryBrush}" />
                                            <TextBlock Text="开始字幕前，请先在“设置 → 识别服务”中填写 API Key。"
                                                       Style="{StaticResource CaptionText}"
                                                       TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                                       Margin="0,2,0,0" />
                                        </StackPanel>
                                    </DockPanel>
                                </Border>

                                <!-- 层级一：演播控制带 (Hero Stage) -->
                                <Border x:Name="HomeControlBar"
                                        Style="{StaticResource HeroPanelBorder}">
                                    <StackPanel>
                                        <!-- 第一排：主操作按钮 + 运行状态摘要 -->
                                        <DockPanel Margin="0,0,0,18">
                                            <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                                                        Orientation="Horizontal"
                                                        VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                                <ui:Button x:Name="StartStopButton"
                                                           AutomationProperties.AutomationId="StartStopButton"
                                                           Appearance="Primary"
                                                           Click="OnStartStopClick"
                                                           Height="38"
                                                           MinWidth="132"
                                                           Padding="16,0"
                                                           Margin="0,0,10,0">
                                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                                        <ui:ProgressRing x:Name="StartStopProgressRing"
                                                                         IsIndeterminate="True"
                                                                         Width="16"
                                                                         Height="16"
                                                                         Margin="0,0,8,0"
                                                                         Visibility="Collapsed" />
                                                        <ui:SymbolIcon x:Name="StartStopIcon" Symbol="Play24" Margin="0,0,8,0" />
                                                        <TextBlock x:Name="StartStopText" Text="开始字幕" FontWeight="SemiBold" />
                                                    </StackPanel>
                                                </ui:Button>
                                                <ui:Button x:Name="HomeFloatingWindowButton"
                                                           AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeFloatingWindowButton"
                                                           AutomationProperties.Name="显示悬浮窗"
                                                           Click="OnShowFloatingWindowClick"
                                                           Height="38"
                                                           MinWidth="116"
                                                           Margin="0,0,8,0">
                                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                                        <ui:SymbolIcon x:Name="FloatingWindowIcon" Symbol="Window24" Margin="0,0,8,0" />
                                                        <TextBlock x:Name="HomeFloatingWindowText" Text="显示悬浮窗" />
                                                    </StackPanel>
                                                </ui:Button>
                                                <ui:Button x:Name="HomeFloatingLockButton"
                                                           AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeFloatingLockButton"
                                                           ToolTip="锁定或解锁悬浮窗（Ctrl+Alt+L）"
                                                           Click="OnToggleFloatingLockClick"
                                                           Height="38"
                                                           MinWidth="92">
                                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                                        <ui:SymbolIcon x:Name="HomeFloatingLockIcon" Symbol="LockClosed24" Margin="0,0,6,0" />
                                                        <TextBlock x:Name="HomeFloatingLockText" Text="锁定" />
                                                    </StackPanel>
                                                </ui:Button>
                                            </StackPanel>

                                            <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                                        HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                                                        VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                        Margin="16,0,0,0">
                                                <TextBlock x:Name="HomeRuntimeSummaryText"
                                                           AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeControlBar"
                                                           Text="未启动，等待开始"
                                                           FontSize="13"
                                                           FontWeight="Medium"
                                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorPrimaryBrush}"
                                                           HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                                                           TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                                                <TextBlock x:Name="HomeActiveServiceSummaryText"
                                                           Text="识别：MiMo ASR · 翻译：已关闭"
                                                           Style="{StaticResource CaptionText}"
                                                           HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                                                           Margin="0,2,0,0"
                                                           TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                                            </StackPanel>
                                        </DockPanel>

                                        <!-- 第二排：高频快捷切换带（输出设备 + 翻译开关与目标语言） -->
                                        <Border Background="{DynamicResource SubtleFillColorSecondaryBrush}"
                                                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource CardStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                                                BorderThickness="1"
                                                CornerRadius="8"
                                                Padding="14,10"
                                                Margin="0,0,0,18">
                                            <Grid>
                                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="1.25*" />
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="20" />
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="20" />
                                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="1*" />
                                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                                                <!-- 输出设备快捷选择 -->
                                                <DockPanel Grid.Column="0" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                                    <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                                                               Text="输出设备"
                                                               FontSize="12"
                                                               FontWeight="Medium"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorSecondaryBrush}"
                                                               VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                               Margin="0,0,10,0" />
                                                    <ui:Button x:Name="HomeRefreshAudioDevicesButton"
                                                               DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                                               ToolTip="刷新音频输出设备列表"
                                                               Width="32"
                                                               Height="32"
                                                               Padding="0"
                                                               Margin="6,0,0,0"
                                                               Click="OnRefreshAudioDevicesClick">
                                                        <ui:SymbolIcon Symbol="ArrowClockwise24" FontSize="14" />
                                                    </ui:Button>
                                                    <ComboBox x:Name="HomeAudioDeviceComboBox"
                                                              AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeAudioDeviceComboBox"
                                                              Height="32"
                                                              SelectionChanged="OnHomeAudioDeviceSelectionChanged" />
                                                </DockPanel>

                                                <Border Grid.Column="2"
                                                        Width="1"
                                                        Height="22"
                                                        Background="{DynamicResource DividerStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                                                        VerticalAlignment="Center" />

                                                <!-- 翻译快速开关与目标语言 -->
                                                <DockPanel x:Name="HomeTranslationQuickBar"
                                                           Grid.Column="4"
                                                           VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                                    <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                                                               Text="字幕翻译"
                                                               FontSize="12"
                                                               FontWeight="Medium"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorSecondaryBrush}"
                                                               VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                               Margin="0,0,10,0" />
                                                    <ui:ToggleSwitch x:Name="HomeTranslationEnabledSwitch"
                                                                     AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeTranslationEnabledSwitch"
                                                                     DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                                                                     OffContent="关"
                                                                     OnContent="开"
                                                                     Margin="0,0,10,0"
                                                                     VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                                     Checked="OnHomeTranslationEnabledChanged"
                                                                     Unchecked="OnHomeTranslationEnabledChanged" />
                                                    <ComboBox x:Name="HomeTranslationTargetLanguageBox"
                                                              AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeTranslationTargetLanguageBox"
                                                              Height="32"
                                                              MinWidth="112"
                                                              SelectionChanged="OnHomeTranslationTargetLanguageChanged">
                                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="译为 中文" Tag="zh-Hans" />
                                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="译为 英语" Tag="en" />
                                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="译为 德语" Tag="de" />
                                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="译为 法语" Tag="fr" />
                                                        <ComboBoxItem Content="译为 日语" Tag="ja" />
                                                    </ComboBox>
                                                </DockPanel>
                                            </Grid>
                                        </Border>

                                        <!-- 保留 CurrentAudioDeviceText 供现有逻辑与 UIA 自动化兼容 -->
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="CurrentAudioDeviceText"
                                                   AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeAudioDeviceText"
                                                   Text="默认设备"
                                                   Height="0"
                                                   Opacity="0"
                                                   IsHitTestVisible="False" />

                                        <!-- 第三排：分段 LED 声学电平仪 + 实时人声/识别状态灯 -->
                                        <Grid>
                                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto" />
                                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="0"
                                                       Text="输入电平"
                                                       FontSize="12"
                                                       FontWeight="Medium"
                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorSecondaryBrush}"
                                                       VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                       Margin="0,0,12,0" />

                                            <Grid Grid.Column="1" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                                <controls:SegmentedLevelMeter x:Name="AudioLevelMeter"
                                                                              Height="14"
                                                                              SegmentCount="32"
                                                                              InactiveBrush="{DynamicResource AcousticMeterTrackBrush}"
                                                                              NormalBrush="{DynamicResource AcousticLiveBrush}"
                                                                              WarmBrush="{DynamicResource AcousticWarmBrush}"
                                                                              PeakBrush="{DynamicResource AcousticPeakBrush}" />
                                                <!-- 保留 ProgressBar 隐藏于底层，保持 HomeAudioLevelBar 的 UIA 契约 -->
                                                <ProgressBar x:Name="AudioLevelBar"
                                                             AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeAudioLevelBar"
                                                             AutomationProperties.Name="输入电平"
                                                             Minimum="0"
                                                             Maximum="100"
                                                             Height="1"
                                                             Opacity="0"
                                                             IsHitTestVisible="False" />
                                            </Grid>

                                            <TextBlock x:Name="HomeAudioLevelText"
                                                       Grid.Column="2"
                                                       Text="0%"
                                                       Width="40"
                                                       TextAlignment="Right"
                                                       FontSize="12"
                                                       FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                       Typography.NumeralAlignment="Tabular"
                                                       Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorPrimaryBrush}"
                                                       VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                       Margin="10,0,12,0" />

                                            <Border x:Name="HomeVoiceActivityBadge"
                                                    Grid.Column="3"
                                                    Background="{DynamicResource SubtleFillColorSecondaryBrush}"
                                                    BorderBrush="{DynamicResource CardStrokeColorDefaultBrush}"
                                                    BorderThickness="1"
                                                    CornerRadius="10"
                                                    Padding="9,3"
                                                    VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                                <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                                    <Ellipse x:Name="HomeVoiceActivityDot"
                                                             Width="7"
                                                             Height="7"
                                                             Fill="{DynamicResource AcousticIdleBrush}"
                                                             Margin="0,0,6,0"
                                                             VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                                    <TextBlock x:Name="HomeVoiceActivityText"
                                                               Text="未监听"
                                                               FontSize="11.5"
                                                               FontWeight="Medium"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorSecondaryBrush}"
                                                               VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                                </StackPanel>
                                            </Border>
                                        </Grid>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </Border>

                                <!-- 层级二：5 节点横向运行链路条 (Pipeline Strip) -->
                                <Border Style="{StaticResource PanelBorder}" Padding="20,16">
                                    <StackPanel>
                                        <DockPanel Margin="0,0,0,12">
                                            <TextBlock Text="运行链路"
                                                       AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeOverviewPanel"
                                                       Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleText}"
                                                       Margin="0"
                                                       VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                            <TextBlock x:Name="HomePipelineHintText"
                                                       DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                                       Text="音频捕获 → VAD 断句 → 语音识别 → 字幕翻译 → 字幕输出"
                                                       Style="{StaticResource CaptionText}"
                                                       HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                                                       VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                        </DockPanel>

                                        <Grid>
                                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="20" />
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="20" />
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="20" />
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="20" />
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                                            <!-- 节点 1：音频捕获 -->
                                            <Border x:Name="PipelineNodeAudio"
                                                    Grid.Column="0"
                                                    Style="{StaticResource PipelineNodeBorder}">
                                                <StackPanel>
                                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,6">
                                                        <Ellipse x:Name="PipelineDotAudio"
                                                                 Width="7"
                                                                 Height="7"
                                                                 Fill="{DynamicResource AcousticIdleBrush}"
                                                                 Margin="0,0,6,0"
                                                                 VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                                        <TextBlock Text="音频捕获"
                                                                   FontSize="12"
                                                                   FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorPrimaryBrush}" />
                                                    </StackPanel>
                                                    <TextBlock x:Name="AudioStatusText"
                                                               AutomationProperties.AutomationId="OverviewAudioInputStatus"
                                                               Text="未启动"
                                                               FontSize="12"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorSecondaryBrush}"
                                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                                                               ToolTip="{Binding Text, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}" />
                                                </StackPanel>
                                            </Border>

                                            <ui:SymbolIcon Grid.Column="1"
                                                           Symbol="ChevronRight16"
                                                           FontSize="12"
                                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorTertiaryBrush}"
                                                           HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />

                                            <!-- 节点 2：VAD 断句 -->
                                            <Border x:Name="PipelineNodeVad"
                                                    Grid.Column="2"
                                                    Style="{StaticResource PipelineNodeBorder}">
                                                <StackPanel>
                                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,6">
                                                        <Ellipse x:Name="PipelineDotVad"
                                                                 Width="7"
                                                                 Height="7"
                                                                 Fill="{DynamicResource AcousticIdleBrush}"
                                                                 Margin="0,0,6,0"
                                                                 VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                                        <TextBlock Text="VAD 断句"
                                                                   FontSize="12"
                                                                   FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorPrimaryBrush}" />
                                                    </StackPanel>
                                                    <TextBlock x:Name="VadStatusText"
                                                               AutomationProperties.AutomationId="OverviewSpeechDetectionStatus"
                                                               Text="等待模型"
                                                               FontSize="12"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorSecondaryBrush}"
                                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                                                               ToolTip="{Binding Text, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}" />
                                                </StackPanel>
                                            </Border>

                                            <ui:SymbolIcon Grid.Column="3"
                                                           Symbol="ChevronRight16"
                                                           FontSize="12"
                                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorTertiaryBrush}"
                                                           HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />

                                            <!-- 节点 3：语音识别 (进程 + 接口合并呈现，保留两个独立 AutomationId) -->
                                            <Border x:Name="PipelineNodeAsr"
                                                    Grid.Column="4"
                                                    Style="{StaticResource PipelineNodeBorder}">
                                                <StackPanel>
                                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,6">
                                                        <Ellipse x:Name="PipelineDotAsr"
                                                                 Width="7"
                                                                 Height="7"
                                                                 Fill="{DynamicResource AcousticIdleBrush}"
                                                                 Margin="0,0,6,0"
                                                                 VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                                        <TextBlock Text="语音识别"
                                                                   FontSize="12"
                                                                   FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorPrimaryBrush}" />
                                                    </StackPanel>
                                                    <TextBlock x:Name="WorkerStatusText"
                                                               AutomationProperties.AutomationId="OverviewRecognitionWorkerStatus"
                                                               Text="未启动"
                                                               FontSize="12"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorSecondaryBrush}"
                                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                                                               ToolTip="{Binding Text, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}" />
                                                    <TextBlock x:Name="ApiStatusText"
                                                               AutomationProperties.AutomationId="OverviewRecognitionApiStatus"
                                                               Text="未测试"
                                                               FontSize="11"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorTertiaryBrush}"
                                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                                                               Margin="0,2,0,0"
                                                               ToolTip="{Binding Text, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}" />
                                                </StackPanel>
                                            </Border>

                                            <ui:SymbolIcon Grid.Column="5"
                                                           Symbol="ChevronRight16"
                                                           FontSize="12"
                                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorTertiaryBrush}"
                                                           HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />

                                            <!-- 节点 4：字幕翻译 (进程 + 接口合并呈现，保留两个独立 AutomationId) -->
                                            <Border x:Name="PipelineNodeTranslation"
                                                    Grid.Column="6"
                                                    Style="{StaticResource PipelineNodeBorder}">
                                                <StackPanel>
                                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,6">
                                                        <Ellipse x:Name="PipelineDotTranslation"
                                                                 Width="7"
                                                                 Height="7"
                                                                 Fill="{DynamicResource AcousticIdleBrush}"
                                                                 Margin="0,0,6,0"
                                                                 VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                                        <TextBlock Text="字幕翻译"
                                                                   FontSize="12"
                                                                   FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorPrimaryBrush}" />
                                                    </StackPanel>
                                                    <TextBlock x:Name="TranslationWorkerStatusText"
                                                               AutomationProperties.AutomationId="OverviewTranslationWorkerStatus"
                                                               Text="已关闭"
                                                               FontSize="12"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorSecondaryBrush}"
                                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                                                               ToolTip="{Binding Text, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}" />
                                                    <TextBlock x:Name="TranslationApiStatusText"
                                                               AutomationProperties.AutomationId="OverviewTranslationApiStatus"
                                                               Text="已关闭"
                                                               FontSize="11"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorTertiaryBrush}"
                                                               TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"
                                                               Margin="0,2,0,0"
                                                               Typography.NumeralAlignment="Tabular"
                                                               ToolTip="{Binding Text, RelativeSource={RelativeSource Self}}" />
                                                </StackPanel>
                                            </Border>

                                            <ui:SymbolIcon Grid.Column="7"
                                                           Symbol="ChevronRight16"
                                                           FontSize="12"
                                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorTertiaryBrush}"
                                                           HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                                           VerticalAlignment="Center" />

                                            <!-- 节点 5：字幕输出 -->
                                            <Border x:Name="PipelineNodeOutput"
                                                    Grid.Column="8"
                                                    Style="{StaticResource PipelineNodeBorder}">
                                                <StackPanel>
                                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,6">
                                                        <Ellipse x:Name="PipelineDotOutput"
                                                                 Width="7"
                                                                 Height="7"
                                                                 Fill="{DynamicResource AcousticIdleBrush}"
                                                                 Margin="0,0,6,0"
                                                                 VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                                        <TextBlock Text="字幕输出"
                                                                   FontSize="12"
                                                                   FontWeight="SemiBold"
                                                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorPrimaryBrush}" />
                                                    </StackPanel>
                                                    <TextBlock x:Name="SubtitleOutputStatusText"

                                                <RowDefinition Height="Auto" />

                                        <ui:Button DockPanel.Dock="Right"

                                        <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center">

                                                       FontWeight="SemiBold"

                                            <TextBlock Text="开始字幕前，请先在“设置 → 识别服务”中填写 API Key。"

                                    </DockPanel>
                                </Border>

                                <Border x:Name="HomeControlBar"
                                        Style="{StaticResource PanelBorder}">
                                    <StackPanel>
                                        <DockPanel Margin="0,0,0,20">
                                            <TextBlock Text="字幕概览"
                                                       AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeOverviewPanel"
                                                       Style="{StaticResource SectionTitleText}"
                                                       Margin="0"
                                                       VerticalAlignment="Center" />
                                            <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                                        Orientation="Horizontal"
                                                        HorizontalAlignment="Right">
                                                <ui:Button x:Name="StartStopButton"
                                                           AutomationProperties.AutomationId="StartStopButton"
                                                           Appearance="Primary"
                                                           Click="OnStartStopClick"
                                                           MinWidth="116"
                                                           Margin="0,0,8,0">
                                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                                        <ui:ProgressRing x:Name="StartStopProgressRing"

                                                                         Height="16"
                                                                         Margin="0,0,8,0"
                                                                         Visibility="Collapsed" />
                                                        <ui:SymbolIcon x:Name="StartStopIcon" Symbol="Play24" Margin="0,0,8,0" />
                                                        <TextBlock x:Name="StartStopText" Text="开始字幕" />
                                                    </StackPanel>
                                                </ui:Button>
                                                <ui:Button x:Name="HomeFloatingWindowButton"
                                                           AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeFloatingWindowButton"
                                                           AutomationProperties.Name="显示悬浮窗"
                                                           Click="OnShowFloatingWindowClick"
                                                           MinWidth="112"
                                                           Margin="0,0,8,0">
                                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                                        <ui:SymbolIcon x:Name="FloatingWindowIcon" Symbol="Window24" Margin="0,0,8,0" />
                                                        <TextBlock x:Name="HomeFloatingWindowText" Text="显示悬浮窗" />
                                                    </StackPanel>
                                                </ui:Button>
                                                <ui:Button x:Name="HomeFloatingLockButton"
                                                           AutomationProperties.AutomationId="HomeFloatingLockButton"
                                                           ToolTip="锁定或解锁悬浮窗（Ctrl+Alt+L）"
                                                           Click="OnToggleFloatingLockClick"
                                                           MinWidth="96">
                                                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                                                        <ui:SymbolIcon x:Name="HomeFloatingLockIcon" Symbol="LockClosed24" Margin="0,0,6,0" />
                                                        <TextBlock x:Name="HomeFloatingLockText" Text="锁定" />
                                                    </StackPanel>
                                                </ui:Button>
                                            </StackPanel>
                                        </DockPanel>

                                        <Grid Margin="0,0,0,24">
                                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="24" />
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*" />
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="24" />
                                                <ColumnDefinition Width="300" />
                                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                                            <StackPanel Grid.Column="0">
                                                <TextBlock Text="当前状态" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabelText}" />
                                                <TextBlock x:Name="HomeRuntimeSummaryText"

                                                           Text="未启动，等待开始"

                                            <StackPanel Grid.Column="2">

                                                           FontSize="14"
                                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource TextFillColorPrimaryBrush}"
                                                           TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis" />
                                            </StackPanel>
                                            <StackPanel Grid.Column="4">
                                                <DockPanel Margin="0,0,0,8">
                                                    <TextBlock Text="输入电平" Style="{StaticResource FieldLabelText}" Margin="0" />
                                                    <TextBlock x:Name="HomeAudioLevelText"
                                                               DockPanel.Dock="Right"
                                                               Text="0%"
                                                               Style="{StaticResource CaptionText}"
                                                               HorizontalAlignment="Right" />
                                                </DockPanel>
                                                <ProgressBar x:Name="AudioLevelBar"
